normalization.model: trimmed vendor SKU; never prompt text
normalization.amount: finite nonnegative major currency amount -> integer minor units, rounded half away from zero
normalization.currency: trimmed uppercase ISO-style code; default USD only when column is absent
normalization.api_key_name: shape signal only; never treated as a credential or retained

normalization.date: strict ISO calendar date -> usage date
normalization.model: trimmed vendor SKU; never prompt text
normalization.cost_usd: finite nonnegative major currency amount -> integer minor units, rounded half away from zero
normalization.currency: trimmed uppercase ISO-style code; default USD only when column is absent
normalization.api_key: shape signal only; never treated as a credential or retained

unsupported_shape_behavior.missing_required_column: reject that file before reading rows; identify missing column names; do not guess or substitute an optional field
unsupported_shape_behavior.unknown_header_shape: return unsupported_format; preserve no rows; offer manual mapping in the existing client-side intake
unsupported_shape_behavior.ambiguous_shape: return unsupported_format; never select the nearest-looking provider
unsupported_shape_behavior.reordered_columns: accept; match normalized header names, never column positions
unsupported_shape_behavior.unknown_columns: ignore unless they contain prohibited prompt or credential material; never retain ignored values
unsupported_shape_behavior.malformed_row: reject the whole native export when any contract-required cell cannot be read; name the first invalid row and column; analyze no subtotal from the remaining rows and do not coerce invalid values to zero
unsupported_shape_behavior.partial_export: analyze valid rows as partial evidence and disclose skipped-row counts; never present the subtotal as complete
unsupported_shape_behavior.stale_export: the native CSV has no trustworthy export timestamp; report freshness as unknown rather than infer it from usage dates

privacy_and_runtime.credentials: prohibited; no API keys, tokens, logins, or provider-account access are requested or used
privacy_and_runtime.network_requests: prohibited during import; files are read with the browser File API only
privacy_and_runtime.prompt_content: prohibited from normalized output, UI, logs, exports, or retained state
privacy_and_runtime.customer_data_persistence: prohibited; raw rows and customer identifiers are never persisted, remain in memory for the tab, and are discarded on refresh or explicit discard
privacy_and_runtime.live_connections: prohibited; no live provider, HRIS, or identity connection is part of this contract
